# VariantStoryBench

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/RGenomicsETL/VariantStoryBench/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RGenomicsETL/VariantStoryBench/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

VariantStoryBench validates rare-disease prioritization results and calculates benchmark metrics.
The selected study direction uses public data throughout, alongside
[VariantStory](https://github.com/RGenomicsETL/VariantStory/pull/7).

## Public-data path

The [public-data plan](public-data-plan.md) defines source selection, preparation,
engine adapters, temporal comparisons, and publication.
Publish source manifests, selection rules, benchmark labels, evaluation scripts,
run configuration, and results here as each step is implemented.

```text
public callsets / case records / provider releases
    -> reproducible input preparation
    -> VariantStory execution
    -> validated results
    -> public metrics and reports
```

Keep public benchmark labels separate from engine inputs.
Use public callsets for transport and scale checks.
Use eligible public cases for prioritization within their declared candidate universe.
Use public provider releases for evidence-change and temporal comparisons.
Do not invent missing case fields or describe technical checks as diagnostic yield.

This direction does not depend on a private cohort or generated study cases.
Existing micro-cohorts remain developer fixtures, not the research population or a prerequisite for this plan.

## Implemented and planned

| Available now | Still to implement for the public study |
|---|---|
| Result-relation validators and explicit-denominator metrics | Public source inventory and preparation scripts |
| Allele/genotype transport, phenotype, and frequency checks | Bundled VariantStory engine adapter |
| Developer fixture generation and contract tests | Executable temporal selection and published study runs |

The package does not implement a diagnostic prioritizer or replace provider loaders.
See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) for current responsibilities and
[benchmark-contract.md](benchmark-contract.md) for schemas and metrics.
See [temporal-benchmark.md](temporal-benchmark.md) for the temporal design;
the public-data plan selects the parts used by this study.

## Install

```r
remotes::install_github("RGenomicsETL/VariantStoryBench")
```

## Result contract

Adapters emit declared `runs`, `evaluations`, and `candidates`.
Ranks are unique and contiguous per run/case/target, with candidate-ID tie breaking.
Failed, skipped, and unsupported known-causal units remain ranking misses.
Source spans use nonempty zero-based half-open intervals.

`bench_validate_frequency_observations()` checks typed case-frequency outputs,
including exact VariantKey text and distinct match, filter, and missing-value states.
It does not assign clinical evidence criteria.
`bench_classification_diff()` compares caller-supplied decisions under the declared policy.
These functions do not imply that a complete public-data adapter already exists.

## Developer checks

`bench_generate_micro_cohort()` and `bench_evaluate_micro_cohort()` remain available for software tests.
Their existing contracts are documented in the architecture and package help.
The current `targets` pipeline generates developer fixtures and checks contracts;
it is not the public study runner and does not invent engine output.

```r
targets::tar_make(callr_function = NULL)
```
